name: Hana Technologies
old_description: Hana Technologies, Inc. – founded in 1999 – can, as a proud family member, trace back to its roots towards 1978, when Hana Microelectronics Public Co., Ltd. established itself as a trailblazer in the electronics sector. The transformation into a public entity in 1993 marked a significant milestone, emphasizing its commitment to growth and innovation. Today Hana is not just a local entity but a global powerhouse with an extensive network of manufacturing facilities. Its presence spans across Thailand, China, the USA, Cambodia, and Korea, showcasing a strategic global footprint in the electronic components industry.
about:
Hana Technologies, Inc. was founded in 1999 in Solon, Ohio, as a member of the Hana Microelectronics Group, a family-owned enterprise that traces its roots to 1978 when Hana Microelectronics Public Co., Ltd. was established in Thailand. The group became a public company in 1993 and now operates a global network of manufacturing facilities across Thailand, China, the United States, Cambodia, and Korea.

The company provides RFID products and microelectronics manufacturing services, including printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), integrated circuit (IC) assembly and testing, LED production, smart card manufacturing, high-voltage ICs for silicon carbide converters and inverters, and liquid crystal devices.

Hana serves industries such as electronic components, RFID and IoT, automotive (including tire manufacturers), packaging, smart cards, LED lighting, and silicon carbide power electronics. Customers include organizations like the Auburn University RFID Lab and global brands deploying Impinj M830-based inlays such as the Brava and TX5015 models.

Hana emphasizes quality and compliance as foundational, maintaining ISO 9001 certification, ARC Quality Certification for RFID products, and RoHS and REACH compliance. The company states it is “fully dedicated to fulfill customer demands” and operates under the motto “Hana Family. Because we care™.”

name: Hansen International Inc.
old_description: Every day, brave men and women hit the road and go to work. They risk their lives to keep our power on, put fires out, and respond to emergencies. With so much riding on getting the job done, there’s no time to waste fumbling around with faulty hardware.
about:
Hansen International, Inc. is headquartered in Lexington, South Carolina, where it has operated since consolidating its manufacturing facilities in 2003. The company traces its roots to 1920 when A.L. "Auggie" Hansen, a Danish immigrant who had worked with Thomas Edison during World War I, founded the business in Chicago. Now in its fourth generation of family ownership, the firm is led by President Lisa Beebe, who assumed the role in 2017.

The company engineers, manufactures, and globally sources commercial and industrial vehicle hardware and trim systems. Its 110,000-square-foot Lexington plant houses assembly, on-site painting, on-site quality testing, stamping, and welding operations. Hansen also provides inventory management, EDI, just-in-time and Kanban supply chain services, custom packaging, and prototype development, supporting both short-run and production volumes.

Primary customers are OEMs and fleet operators in the emergency vehicle, utility truck, and commercial vehicle sectors. The company's hardware — including roll-up doors, D-rings, grab handles, and compartment lighting — is specified on vehicles used by linemen, firefighters, and first responders. Hansen also serves as a global sourcing partner for vehicle component programs.

Hansen emphasizes a "higher standard" of reliability, rooted in a century of engineering-led innovation. The firm highlights its APQP-compliant project management, on-site prototype center, lean manufacturing practices, and CARC paint capabilities as differentiators that ensure durable, mission-ready hardware for customers who cannot afford equipment failure.

name: Hardy Lawn Furniture
old_description: Since 1993, Hardy Lawn Furniture has been your go-to place for durable and diverse outdoor furniture. From swings and gliders to practical storage solutions and comfy dining sets, we’ve got your patio needs covered. The versatility of our offerings guarantees a style solution for every homeowner in the Midwest. Join the community of satisfied customers today and transform your outdoor space into a masterpiece of quality comfort.
about:
Hardy Lawn Furniture was founded in 1993 in Iowa City, Iowa, as a family-owned business specializing in Amish-crafted outdoor furniture. The company began by offering handcrafted pieces built by skilled Amish and Mennonite artisans, establishing a reputation for quality in Central Iowa.

The company manufactures a range of outdoor products including gliders, chairs, picnic tables, swings, dining sets, benches, storage sheds, run-in sheds, detached garages, playhouses, and PlayMor playsets. Every item is built to order in the company's workshops, allowing extensive customization of materials such as wood or poly lumber, colors, finishes, and design features. Assembly uses stainless steel hardware for durability.

Hardy Lawn Furniture serves residential homeowners across the Midwest, with a focus on Central Iowa. Customers visit the showroom on Naples Avenue to select and customize pieces for backyard living, storage, and recreation.

The business operates under the motto "A quality product at an affordable price," emphasizing bespoke craftsmanship and a 10-year warranty against defects in workmanship or materials. The personalized, built-to-order approach and Amish construction methods are cited as key differentiators.

old_description: Harvest Market was founded in 1995 to provide Hockessin and the surrounding communities with a broad selection of wholesome and nourishing foods, nutritional supplements and related products. Now in our third location, we have expanded to offer one of the region’s best selections of natural foods—or what our great-grandparents simply called “food”. about:
Harvest Market was founded in 1995 in Hockessin, Delaware, to supply the local community with a broad selection of wholesome foods, nutritional supplements, and related products. The business has since expanded to its third location at 7417 Lancaster Pike, broadening its offering to one of the region's most extensive selections of natural foods.

The company operates as a natural foods retailer with a dedicated kitchen facility. In 2013, Harvest Market opened the Harvest Market Kitchen, which produces grab-and-go soups, salads, sandwiches, sides, and sweets made from scratch using the same ingredients sold in the store. The retail operation includes grocery, perishables, cheese, and wellness departments.

Harvest Market serves residential customers in Hockessin and the surrounding Delaware communities. The store operates Monday through Saturday from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. and Sunday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., providing daily access to natural foods and prepared meals.

The business was started to provide foods that reflect what earlier generations simply called "food"—wholesome and nourishing. The kitchen extends that mission by offering ready-to-eat items prepared with the same high-quality ingredients available on the shelves.

name: Hawaii Solar Outfitters
old_description: Hawaii Solar Outfitters specializes in off-grid solar — no HELCO interconnection queue, no county permitting delay for new builds. Got an existing off-grid system where the generator's running too much? Free system health check using real load testing, not guesswork. Grid-tied systems available too. Just me — no sales team, no commissions.
about:
Hawaii Solar Outfitters operates from Pāhoa on the Big Island of Hawaii. Founder Tim Heltzel launched the company after a decade of solar installation experience in East Hawaii, driven by frustration with large firms that priced out homeowners and forced them through lengthy utility interconnection queues and county permitting processes. The business remains a sole proprietorship with no sales staff or commissioned representatives.

The company designs and installs off-grid and grid-tied solar power systems, specializing in off-grid configurations that avoid HELCO interconnection requirements. Heltzel personally handles every project — from system sizing and component selection to installation and follow-up. Typical installations use SUNKET 430W UL-listed solar panels, EG4 hybrid inverters, and EG4 LiFePO4 battery storage sized for Hawaii's climate. A free off-grid health check includes real-world battery load testing and full site analysis.

Hawaii Solar Outfitters serves residential customers across East Hawaii, including Hilo, Keaau, Pahoa, Mountain View, Fern Forest, Fern Acres, and Volcano. Projects range from basic cabin systems starting around $10,000 to full homestead installations with heavy loads such as air conditioning and well pumps. The installer also works with existing off-grid systems that suffer from excessive generator run-time or battery degradation.

Heltzel emphasizes direct accountability: the same person who designs the system installs it and returns for any service needs. Components are chosen based on real-world testing in local conditions rather than specifications alone. By eliminating sales commissions and permitting delays for off-grid builds, the company aims to deliver energy independence faster and at lower cost than conventional solar contractors.

name: Hawaii Spring Supply Inc
old_description: Hawaii Spring Supply Inc is your ultimate destination for Truck and Trailer Parts. A locally owned business since 1956, we provide the Honolulu and Hilo communities with a vast inventory of truck and trailer parts. We also build driveshafts and fabricate parts.
about:
Hawaii Spring Supply Inc operates from two locations in Honolulu and Hilo, Hawaii. Founded in 1956, the company has remained a family-owned, locally operated business for over six decades. It identifies as an Asian-owned small business.

The company stocks a large inventory of truck and trailer parts, including suspension components, brakes, clutches, air valves, hitches, tires, wheels, and driveshafts. It also builds custom driveshafts and provides fabrication services for automotive parts. The shop is noted as the last certified spring shop in the state. Services include lighting services, same-day delivery, and pickup/delivery options.

The business serves the truck and trailer market in Hawaii, catering to commercial fleets, owner-operators, and repair shops in Honolulu and Hilo. It is associated with Power Heavy Duty and the National Association of Trailer Manufacturers (NATM). Customers include those needing trailer parts, truck parts, driveshafts, and custom fabrication.

The company emphasizes its legacy of excellence, knowledgeable staff, and manufacturer warranties as differentiators. Its certification as the last spring shop in the state underscores a commitment to quality and service.

name: Hayden Valley Foods
old_description: From roasting and coating to mixing, packaging and distribution - we bring snack and confection manufacturing together under one roof so you can move faster, simplify sourcing, and deliver with confidence.
about:
Hayden Valley Foods operates from Urbancrest, Ohio, where it was founded in 1966 by Garland Williamson. The company remains family-owned, having grown from a relationship-driven business across the South into a large-scale snack and confection manufacturing partner.

The 150,000-square-foot facility integrates roasting, coating and enrobing, mixing and custom blending, packaging, distribution, and product development under one roof. Capabilities include nut and snack ingredient roasting, chocolate and yogurt coatings, trail mix formulation, and flexible retail and foodservice packaging, supporting scalable batch production for high-volume programs.

The company serves brands, retailers, distributors, and private-label partners in the snack and confection sectors. Its offerings span bulk ingredient supply, private label manufacturing, branded snack programs, and seasonal and gifting solutions, with end-to-end supply chain support from concept to shelf.

Hayden Valley Foods emphasizes family-owned accountability, integrity, and partnership as its differentiators. The company combines those values with modern production systems and certified quality standards—SQF, BC Probiotic, Kosher, and FDA registration—to deliver consistency and speed from idea to commercialization.

name: Headwaters Woodworking
old_description: Headwaters Woodworking was founded in 2023 by Preston Brown, who built his first dining table as a legacy for his son—a place where family could come together daily and create lasting memories. That same spirit lives in every piece we craft, helping families slow down, reconnect, and build traditions that last for generations.
about:
Headwaters Woodworking operates from Lafayette in Boulder County, Colorado, just north of Denver. The shop was founded in 2023 by Preston Brown, who built his first dining table as a legacy for his son—a piece meant to gather family daily and create lasting memories. That origin story still guides the small, owner-operated business today.

The company produces handcrafted custom hardwood furniture, including dining tables, benches, chairs, and kitchen and living room pieces. Each item is made from premium, sustainably sourced American hardwoods and reclaimed specialty woods, shaped using traditional woodworking methods. The shop serves both residential and commercial clients, delivering finished pieces throughout the Denver metropolitan area and the broader Front Range, from Fort Collins to Colorado Springs.

Customers range from homeowners seeking heirloom-quality dining sets to businesses furnishing offices and hospitality spaces. The shop has supplied custom tables and seating for clients across Boulder, Louisville, Erie, Westminster, and mountain communities in Summit and Clear Creek counties. Orders are taken through a consultation process where clients specify style, materials, and dimensions.

Brown started the business to help families slow down and reconnect around furniture built to last generations. The company emphasizes personal design collaboration, sustainable material sourcing, and local delivery as its defining attributes.

name: Heintz Steel & Manufacturing Company
old_description: We have the experience, skill, and equipment needed for just about any custom metal fabrication project. We welcome the opportunity for custom fabrication work. Give us a call to discuss your fabrication needs.
about:
Heintz Steel & Manufacturing Company operates from a 30,000-square-foot facility on Hall Street in St. Louis, Missouri. The business was founded in 1924 by William Heintz and has remained in continuous operation for over nine decades, making it one of the area’s longest-running industrial fabricators.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication including cutting, shearing, rolling, forming, and welding (MIG, TIG, and stick) on ferrous and non‑ferrous metals such as aluminum, cast iron, hardened steel, mild steel, and stainless steel. Equipment includes automatic saws, press brakes, angle rolls, plate rolls, and burning centers, all driven by CAD/CAM and computerized controllers. Welding procedures are AWS certified.

Heintz serves industrial customers requiring large‑scale fabrications; the company emphasizes a “bigger is better” philosophy to handle oversized parts. Its workforce is largely trained in‑house and works under a partnership with Shopmen’s Local 518 of the International Association of Bridge, Structural and Ornamental Iron Workers.

The firm differentiates itself through its capacity for large weldments, in‑house metallurgical expertise, and a quality system built on rigid controls and dependable service.

name: Hemeixin Electronics Co.,Ltd｜PCB Manufacturer
old_description: Hemeixin Electronics Co., Limited is one quick-turn manufacturer of prototype, various types and low volume PCBs in the world; to offer personalized one-stop solution matching the local various types and quick turn
about:
Hemeixin Electronics Co., Ltd is headquartered in San Jose, California, with its own state-of-the-art PCB fabrication facilities in China. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It was established to provide quick-turn prototype, low-volume, and production printed circuit boards with a personalized one-stop service model.

The company manufactures rigid, flexible, and rigid-flex PCBs, including high-density interconnect (HDI) boards up to 58 layers, high-frequency and microwave circuits, heavy copper designs up to 30 oz, and boards with blind/buried vias, microvias, via-in-pad, cavity structures, and back drilling. It also offers in-house PCB assembly (SMT, through-hole, turnkey, consigned) and design-for-manufacturability checks. Standard lead times are advertised as fast as 72 hours for quick-turn orders, with full turnkey service within five days.

Hemeixin serves customers in portable communications, networking equipment, high-speed digital, and RF/microwave applications. Its materials portfolio includes polyimide (Kapton), PET, PEN, LCP, and a wide range of low-loss and high-speed laminates from Isola, Rogers, Arlon, Taconic, and Panasonic. The company's capabilities target designs requiring fine-line traces down to 0.002 inch, BGA pitches to 0.15 mm, and impedance control within ±5%.

The business emphasizes its integrated fabrication and assembly under one roof, a clean factory environment, and an online quoting system that delivers instant pricing for prototypes through volume production.
